title: Verify: Tests import the actual store and never mock it
summary: Guard tests prove the real module is used
description: Add guard tests to game/frontend/tests/uiStoreRealGuard.test.ts asserting no mock functions, the module exports useUiStore, and no vi.mock appears in the store test sources.
acceptance_criteria: Given the imports, when vi.isMockFunction is called on useUiStore and its actions, then false.
Given the namespace import, when keys are read, then useUiStore is present.
Given store test sources read from disk, when searched for vi.mock, then none found.
technical_constraints: Read files with node:fs and node:path relative to import.meta.url; no network

steps.symbol: new: it('store is not a mock')
steps.action: Create the file importing * as mod from '../src/store/uiStore' and { vi, describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'. Assert Object.keys(mod) contains 'useUiStore', vi.isMockFunction(mod.useUiStore) is false, and vi.isMockFunction is false for toggleDrawer, openModal, closeModal, toggleSound and toggleSettings on getState().
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/uiStoreRealGuard.test.ts -t 'not a mock'

steps.symbol: new: it('no vi.mock in store tests')
steps.action: Read uiStoreReal.test.ts, uiStoreDrawerModal.test.ts, uiStoreSoundSettings.test.ts and uiStoreHook.test.tsx with readFileSync from the same directory (fileURLToPath of import.meta.url) and assert none matches /vi\.mock\(/ while each contains "../src/store/uiStore".
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/uiStoreRealGuard.test.ts
